event: The US Trade Representative announced the results of a Section 301 investigation into excess production capacity covering 14 economies, proposing an additional tariff of up to 18% on Indonesian goods, and Industry Minister Sarmuji said Indonesia will seek new export markets.
key_numbers: Proposed extra tariff up to 18% (Indonesia) · Malaysia 18% · Cambodia 18% · Vietnam 20% · India 17% (per Suara.com) · 14 economies investigated · USTR announced 25 Nov US time · public hearing Jan 2027 · sectors named: textiles, footwear, metal products, renewable-energy components

event: The rupiah hit a new record low on 26 November, trading at Rp18,390 per US dollar at 13:32 WIB and briefly breaching Rp18,400, and Bank Indonesia blamed US rate-hike expectations, a strong dollar index, reclassification worries and month-end corporate dollar demand. (update of E1127)
key_numbers: Rp18,390/US$ at 13:32 WIB, -0.44% (Refinitiv, via CNBC Indonesia) · briefly above Rp18,400 intraday (IDN Times) · previous weakest close Rp18,332 on 25 Nov (E1127) · rupiah -8.4% in 2026 (CNBC headline, not verified in body) · BI intervenes via NDF, spot, DNDF and secondary SBN

event: The IHSG closed up 0.86% at 5,242.17 on 26 November, led by BBCA, BRPT, ASII, AADI and BUMI, while the US PCE inflation data and the new US tariff threat weighed on sentiment. (update of E1126)
key_numbers: Close 5,242.17, +44.56 pts, +0.86% · open 5,214.62 · high 5,297.46 · low 5,214.57 · value Rp7.78 triliun · volume 207.57 juta lot · BRPT +14.96% (regional outlet, unverified) · drags: BMRI, BBRI, ISAT, TLKM, TINS · 25 Nov close was 5,197.61 (-0.84%)

event: Danantara COO Dony Oskaria said a Finance Ministry tax exemption for BUMN restructuring lets the state-owned enterprises streamline within 3 years, and that Danantara targets about Rp650 trillion in tax payments to the state. (update of E1099)
key_numbers: Tax exemption for BUMN restructuring, 3 years (incentive reported valid to 2029) · BUMN count to fall from over 1,000 to about 300 · Danantara tax payment target about Rp650 triliun vs Rp567 triliun in 2025 · article's own 'Rp100 triliun increase' does not match the difference (about Rp83 triliun)

event: Danantara CEO Rosan Roeslani told House Commission VI that Danantara Asset Management has 41 strategic projects for the 2027 work plan (RKAP), covering BUMN restructuring, consolidation and a Garuda Indonesia transformation.
key_numbers: 41 projects: 16 continuing + 25 new · restructuring of PTPN, Pos Indonesia, INKA, BUMN Karya · 6 streamlining/consolidation projects · 9 enabler projects · Garuda transformation, KAI infrastructure, Krakatau Steel equity injection · investment values not stated

event: Bank Indonesia Governor Destry Damayanti told House Commission XI that BI's 2027 assumptions are a rupiah of Rp17,800-18,200 per dollar, a BI-Rate of 6% and growth of 5.2-6%, and warned of inflation risk if oil prices keep rising.
key_numbers: Rupiah Rp17,800-18,200/US$ (2027; DPR-BI agreement cited as Rp18,200 by detik) · BI-Rate 6% · growth 5.2-6% (2026: 4.9-5.7%) · inflation within 2.5% ±1% · BI-cited 2027 budget surplus Rp65.3 triliun (headline only) · current BI-Rate 5.75% (hold since Jun, per storyline)

event: The government said fuel stock for Christmas and New Year (Nataru) is kept at about 20 days of cover and that subsidised fuel prices stay unchanged despite higher world oil prices.
key_numbers: Nataru fuel stock about 20 days · Pertalite price Rp10,000/liter held (storyline: held to end-2026) · unsubsidised Pertalite price per Suahasil/Bahlil reported mid-Nov (E0803)

event: President Prabowo warned conglomerates that do not pay taxes or royalties that they will face law enforcement and the new police chief, in a Teachers' Day speech.
key_numbers: No amounts given · offences listed: unpaid tax, unpaid royalties, false reports, misuse of subsidised goods · Kapolri Suyudi Ario Seto and Attorney General ST Burhanuddin named

event: RSPAD Gatot Soebroto doctors handed the health test results of VP candidates Amran Sulaiman and Sugiono to the MPR verification team led by Habiburokhman on Thursday evening; the contents were kept confidential as medical records. (update of E1130)
key_numbers: 2 candidates · tests 26 Nov at RSPAD · results delivered about 19.30 WIB · verification period 24-26 Nov 2026

event: The DPR Baleg and the government agreed on 62 bills for the 2027 Prolegnas Priority list, including amendments to the Pemilu law, and new bills on Penyadapan, Keamanan dan Ketahanan Siber and Pelaksanaan Pidana Mati.
key_numbers: 62 RUU · 45 from DPR · 15 from government · 2 from DPD · agreed at Baleg working meeting 25 Nov 2026

event: Kejaksaan Agung announced it seized Rp55.8 billion in cash, foreign currency, gold and vehicles in a money-laundering (TPPU) case against Arif Kurniawan, named controller of PT Bumi Sentosa Jaya, linked to alleged nickel mining corruption in Southeast Sulawesi.
key_numbers: Rp55,824,713,000 cash · USD 126,200 · gold 37.8 kg · 60 witnesses questioned · about 4,000 documents · case period 2013-2025, TPPU 2021-2026

event: Mekari, an Indonesian HR/payroll software provider, suffered an outage on payday (25 November), drawing complaints from users on social media, per CNBC Indonesia.
key_numbers: Outage on 25 Nov 2026 (payday date) · duration and affected users not confirmed

event: A US court found Huawei guilty of theft and fraud, per CNBC Indonesia headline.
key_numbers: Details of the ruling (damages, plaintiff) not verified

event: CNBC Indonesia reported that US President Trump's aides are distancing themselves from him after he strongly defended Jensen Huang amid the Nvidia CEO controversy. (update of E1112)
key_numbers: Numbers not verified (article not opened)

event: detikInet reported that the seven Anthropic founders' combined wealth has reached Rp3,289 trillion after the IPO. (update of E1114)
key_numbers: Rp3,289 trillion combined (headline figure, not verified in article) · IPO price US$83 (E1114)

event: CNBC Indonesia reported that OECD outlined five barriers to Indonesia joining global semiconductor supply chains.
key_numbers: 5 barriers (list not verified)

event: detikInet reported that Meta's AI tool Muse caused staff unease by showing mysterious bank balances.
key_numbers: Not verified (article not opened)

event: CNBC Indonesia published a scam warning about a new mode of fraudsters posing as police to drain bank accounts, and an intelligence-agency and OJK tips piece on protecting phones and accounts. (update of E1135)
key_numbers: Not verified (articles not opened) · IASC context: 743,589 accounts blocked, Rp967.5 billion victim funds saved (Bisnis, 5 Nov)

event: Search continued at an illegal gold mine in Nanggung (Pongkor), Bogor, where flooding trapped miners; police recovered 13 bodies and about 13 more were still believed trapped. (update of E1142)
key_numbers: 13 bodies recovered · 6 identified by DVI · ~13 still trapped · 26 families reported missing relatives · flood on 23-24 Nov (CNBC headline cites 16 dead, unreconciled)

event: Kupang Regent Yosef Lede admitted committing sexual violence after being named a suspect following a 15-hour examination, and said he will file a pretrial challenge (praperadilan). (update of E1000)
key_numbers: 15-hour examination · suspect named 26 Nov · police say admission matches victim's visum results · victim is a 21-year-old student

event: Government opened the 2026 CPNS civil-servant selection registration on 27 November via SSCASN, with 154,052 positions; Presiden also prepared slots so PPPK teachers over 35 can join CPNS. (update of E1143)
key_numbers: 154,052 formasi · registration opens 27 Nov 2026 · requirements simplified · PPPK teachers aged 35+ may apply

event: Komdigi's Permen No. 7/2026 requires mobile operators Telkomsel, XL and Indosat to block scam-linked numbers within 24 hours of a request and requires biometric SIM registration.
key_numbers: block within 1x24 hours · 103,940 fraud reports 20 Oct 2024-19 Nov 2026 · 67,578 fraud content items handled · announced 24 Nov

event: Antara and fact-checkers flagged a cluster of political hoaxes as most-read: Bahlil opening Ujung Kulon for mining, Jokowi arrested, Gibran summoned by TNI HQ, a Solo demo for Gibran's return, and a Purbaya/Jokowi PSI photo. (update of E1093)
key_numbers: 5 Antara hoax debunks in Terpopuler · Ujung Kulon rhino-truck photo also rated SALAH (25 Nov) · Listyo Sigit prison photo rated SALAH (25 Nov)

event: Prosecutors indicted former MPR Secretary General Ma'ruf Cahyono for receiving gratuities, including using them for his child's wedding.
key_numbers: Rp30.9 billion in alleged gratuities

event: Kapolri Suyudi said Polri destroyed 601.7 tons of narcotics worth Rp61.68 trillion and that 247 foreigners became drug suspects in the past year. (update of E1057)
key_numbers: 601.7 tons · Rp61.68 trillion · 56,000 cases · Rp1,425.6 trillion state money secured · 247 WNA suspects

event: Flooding in Pesisir Selatan, West Sumatra inundated 1,190 houses and cut access.
key_numbers: 1,190 houses flooded · access cut · 26 Nov

event: A 15-year-old junior-high student died in a student brawl (tawuran) in Tangerang, and a mosque caretaker (marbot) in Surabaya burned while sleeping died after treatment.
key_numbers: victim aged 15 · Surabaya suspect faces up to 12 years in prison

event: Police and ministers reported tightened immigration checks after 21 Indonesians nearly recruited as Russian mercenaries. (update of E1134)
key_numbers: 21 WNI prevented · stricter immigration checks announced 24-25 Nov

event: Health test results of the two VP candidates Sugiono and Amran will be announced 1 December, ahead of the MPR plenary on 2 December. (update of E0805)
key_numbers: announce 1 Dec · MPR plenary 2 Dec · 25 doctors involved · results handed by RSPAD to MPR on 26 Nov
